title: 🚀 Fabric Data Lead 🚀
description:
**Data, Engineering \& Architecture \| Alkemiz Pty Ltd.** 




  





**📍 Location** 




 Remote — anywhere in India.
 



**⏰ Availability** 





 🔴
 
 Only Immediate Joiners should apply.
 
 🔴
 




  





**About Alkemiz** 




 Alkemiz is a direct\-hiring IT services company focused on data engineering, analytics, and platform architecture. We build and manage modern data platforms — particularly on Microsoft Fabric — and our teams work hands\-on with Lakehouse architecture, Power BI, and cloud data engineering to deliver real business outcomes for retail\-focused clients. We operate a close\-knit offshore\-onshore delivery model, giving our engineers exposure to Australian retail data challenges within a collaborative, technically strong team that values good architecture, practical judgement, and ownership.
 



 💼
 **About the Role** 




 Alkemiz is looking for a Fabric Data Lead to serve as the technical authority for our Microsoft Fabric estate — ensuring it is well governed, fit for purpose, and aligned to business needs.
 



 The Fabric Data Lead applies strong design and architecture principles with practical judgement, leading DataOps delivery to balance agility, scalability, quality, and performance. You'll work closely with the Power BI reporting team to understand retail reporting requirements, then design data engineering solutions and semantic models that follow sound architecture patterns within operational constraints.
 



 🛠️
 **Key Responsibilities** 




*Fabric Governance* 




 📌 Ensure every Fabric asset has a clear purpose, defined lifecycle, named business owner, and demonstrable business value
 



 📌 Actively monitor Fabric capacity usage and implement practical controls to stay within allocated capacity
 



 📌 Ensure data pipelines are resilient, robust, and supported by effective alerting and monitoring
 



*Solution Design \& Delivery* 




 📌 Translate analytics and business requirements into clear technical requirements and delivery plans
 



 📌 Apply Fabric best practices and DataSecOps principles to design robust, scalable, maintainable solutions
 



 📌 Ensure relational data models, notebook code, SQL procedures, semantic models, and other artefacts are optimised and well designed
 



 📌 Lead the team to deliver well\-architected solutions, using AI responsibly under strong human judgement and accountability
 



*Cross\-Functional Collaboration* 




 📌 Collaborate with business and domain owners, the reporting team, and other IT teams to align priorities and deliver fit\-for\-purpose outcomes
 



 ✅
 **Must\-Have Requirements** 



* 8–12\+ years in data engineering (or data engineering \+ software engineering) and BI, with demonstrated ownership of end\-to\-end solution design
* Minimum 2 years hands\-on Microsoft Fabric delivery
* Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring a data engineering team, including code/design review responsibility
* Track record operating within a fixed platform capacity budget (Fabric capacity SKUs, Databricks DBUs, Synapse pools, or equivalent), making trade\-off decisions to stay within it
* Experience defining or operating within a data governance framework — approval gates, ownership models, lifecycle/retention policy
* Prior experience working in an offshore/onshore delivery team



 ⭐
 **Good\-to\-Have** 



* Microsoft certifications relevant to Fabric/Power BI
* Prior experience in the Retail sector



 🔧
 **Technical Skills** 



* Fabric Lakehouse \& Warehouse design (Medallion Architecture)
* Fabric pipelines \& notebooks (SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark SQL)
* OneLake structure and Direct Lake mode into Power BI
* Power BI semantic model design and DAX
* Fabric capacity administration and workspace governance
* Git\-based version control and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub) for Fabric artefacts
* Security fundamentals: row\-level security, column\-level security, sensitivity labels, secrets management



 📍
 **Location** 




 Remote — anywhere in India.
 



 ⏰
 **Availability** 





 🔴
 
 Only Immediate Joiners should apply.
 
 🔴
 




 📩
 **How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates can DM or send their profile to garima.sharma@alkemiz.com.au

title: Hydraulic Modeler – River
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 The candidate will have below mentioned roles and responsibilities working on multiple projects for UK, ME and/or ANZ clients / lead offices.
   

  

 Main Role Responsibilities
   

  

* Working on various river flood modelling projects and studies in line with client requirement.
* Integrated Hydraulic modelling 1D\-2D model build / updates
* Calibration, validation, impact and mitigation assessment, flood mapping, etc.
* Hydrological modelling
* Internal / external project discussions / meetings and presentations.
* Report writing and co\-ordination with the lead office or client,
* Technical and project support to the team on various project.
* Liaison with lead offices for business development
* Working in collaboration with other disciplines to ensure the integrity of the overall project.
* Project / Team management
* Maintain high work standards, minimise production errors and attention to detail
* Assisting and participating in developing yourself and other team members to their full potential
* Building a profile in the industry and keeping up\-to\-date with innovations and developments.
* Works with Graduate and intermediate hydraulic modellers, senior or lead modellers and project managers
* Support the Team as required.


* Reports to the River Modelling Team Lead and/or Lead office manager.
* Easily approachable and enjoys building relationships
* Enjoys working with people at different levels
* Self\-motivated and keeping up\-to\-date with innovations and developments
* Ready to learn more and train others.
* Key Groups
+ Global Integrated Delivery
+ Hydrology and Hydraulic Modelling
+ GIS processing
+ Management


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

**Essential**
* B.E in Civil Engineering and MS/M.Tech in Water Resources / Environmental Engineering from a recognized University
* 3 to 6 yrs of hands\-on experience in working with integrated 1D\-2D flood modelling projects including storm drainage network.
* Experience on modelling tools such as Tuflow\-Estry, Flood Modeller Pro, Infoworks ICM, HEC\-RAS, HEC\-HMS, etc.
* Experience on GIS tools such as Qgis, ArcGIS, MapInfo, etc.
* Sound technical knowledge and understanding of pluvial, fluvial, and coastal/tidal hydraulic modelling
* Knowledge on hydrology calculations / models and practices related to UK, ME and/or ANZ
* Good report writing, well\-developed interpersonal skills and working in team are seen as essential attributes.


 Desirable
   

  

* Experience with hydrology calculations / models and practices related to UK, ME and/or ANZ will be an added advantage.
* Working towards Chartership or recently Chartered will be advantage.


 Flexible to adopt new work /challenge work as per business requirement.
   

  

 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Company Description** 
 MindLytics is a next\-generation data and analytics company that helps organizations turn raw data into actionable intelligence. The team specializes in building scalable data infrastructure, advanced analytics solutions, and modern visualization platforms to support faster, smarter decision\-making. MindLytics partners with both startups and growing enterprises to enable data\-driven cultures through reliable data pipelines, cloud\-based architectures, and business intelligence solutions. The company’s mission is to convert raw data into real business value by delivering practical, impact\-focused data solutions to its clients.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time remote Data Scientist role focuses on designing and implementing data\-driven solutions that address complex business problems. The Data Scientist will work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to collect, analyze, and model data, and to translate findings into clear, actionable insights. Daily responsibilities include building and validating statistical and machine learning models, performing exploratory data analysis, and developing dashboards or visualizations that communicate key metrics and trends. The role also involves maintaining clean, reliable datasets, contributing to scalable data pipelines, and documenting methodologies to support reproducibility and ongoing improvement.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Data Science and Statistics for modeling, experimentation, and inference.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Analytics and Data Analysis for interpreting complex datasets and generating insights.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Visualization for building clear dashboards and visual reports.
* Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in data science (such as Python or R) and experience with SQL or other query languages.
* Familiarity with machine learning libraries, cloud\-based data platforms, and version control tools.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience working with business intelligence tools and building end\-to\-end analytics solutions is beneficial.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Revenue Operations (India Remote) - Hours 1-9pm IST
description:
**Company Description**
  

 When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
   

  

 Experience a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
   

  

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.
   

  

 You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket\-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong.
   

  

 This is an early\-stage function, so you'll have unusual influence over how it's built.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Lead the migration of legacy Alteryx workflows into documented, tested dbt models on Redshift.
* Design models with deliberate grain and clear lineage, building toward a certified set of marts that reporting reads from.
* Own orchestration, monitoring, and alerting in Dagster (or Airflow), and the ingestion layer feeding it.
* Keep Redshift fast and cost\-effective.
* Trace issues to the right root cause — reporting, data model, or upstream business process — and route each to the right fix.
* Build the data foundations behind RevOps initiatives such as account\-based marketing, customer health scoring, and predictive work like churn and lead scoring.
* Use AI and LLM tooling thoughtfully in the engineering workflow, and help the team form a view on where it belongs.


  

  

**Qualifications**
  

**What We're Looking For**
* A self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, leads with questions, and doesn't wait to be assigned work.
* A translator who can explain a data problem to a Sales Director in terms of their quota, and a quota problem to an engineer in terms of a data model.
* A systems thinker who looks upstream and downstream before proposing a fix.
* Someone constructively skeptical who reconciles the numbers before shipping them.
* Impact\-focused — you deliver the "so what?", not just the data.
* An owner who takes pride in the cleanliness of their code and their documentation.


**Essential**
* 6 \- 8\+ years in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence with substantial hands\-on modeling responsibility.
* Proven experience building and maintaining production\-grade dbt projects, including testing and documentation.
* Hands\-on production experience with Dagster or Airflow.
* Advanced SQL and real experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake / BigQuery), including performance tuning.
* Git\-based workflow, code review, and CI as a normal part of how you work.
* Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce data model.
* Python for data work and automation.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Alteryx, particularly in a migration context.
* Experience with Airbyte, Dagster \& DBT or comparable ELT tooling.
* Salesforce\-specific data modeling experience.
* Exposure to predictive modeling or machine learning workflows.
* Experience with large customer engagement datasets (1M\+ rows).
* Ability to build and maintain Tableau dashboards, even if it isn't your primary craft.


  

  

**Additional Information**
  

**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  

 At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
   

  

 Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
   

  

 In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being.
   

  

**Our Mission** 
 is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
   

  

  

  

**Our Values** 
 underpin everything we do.
   

* **Customer Centric:** 
 Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:** 
 We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:** 
 Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action \& Ownership:** 
 We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:** 
 We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:** 
 We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.


**Global Benefits**
* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self\-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days \+ Juneteenth Observed
* Paid Volunteer Time\*
* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*


 \* varies by country
   

  

**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  

 At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

title: Associate Analyst, Supply Chain Planning
description:
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.
   

  

 ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.
   

  

**About Analog Devices**
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 The Supply Chain team \`has an opening for a Supply Chain Analyst at our Gandhinagar office, India. This position reports to the Manager of Supply Chain. This role will be responsible for analyzing day to day supply chain issues and strategizing permanent improvement. This role will work closely with Supply chain analytics and system teams and will help drive continuous system improvement projects. The successful candidate must have good understanding of key supply chain functions, and hands on experience in analyzing complex issues \& must possess an understanding of supply chain operations.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

* Analyze supply chain key performance indicators and device actionable plans to resolve ongoing issues and identify permanent resolution steps
* Troubleshoot complex planning issues and propose effective solutions.
* Develop new supply chain functionalities and business processes in order to achieve organizational goals
* Improve data analytics, identify ways of data governance and automate tasks to support wider analytics group
* Support users on day\-to\-day questions and system issues. Monitor and maintain system processes and documentation of support processes and procedures.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* BE \- Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial, Manufacturing, Operations Research, Production
* 0 \- 3years of relevant experience
* Hands on SQL / PLSQL / Tableau / Basic \& Advanced Excel
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills are a must
* High sense of ownership and accountability. Ability to drive improvement with cross functional team globally
* Hands on Python is added advantage and experience in driving improvements using machine learning
* Flexible to work in different Time Zones

As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

 Job Req Type: Graduate Job
